_comment_mode: free = only what a free API key sustains (DuckDuckGo instead of grounded search, lite model, no continuous vision). paid = everything on.
_comment_location: Overrides everything else for the local news briefing. 'City' or 'City, Region'. Leave empty to use a city stored in memory, then IP geolocation.
_comment_ip_geolocation: Set false to never look up your location by IP. Skipped anyway whenever a city is already known from 'location' above or from long-term memory.
